new_trusted_entries.name: errno
new_trusted_entries.notes: Проверено агентом, не человеком. Publisher trust for safe-to-deploy, not an independent complete source audit. Trust Chris Wong (lambda-fairy), named author and exact upstream release-commit author/publisher, for production platform errno ABI, thread-local get/set, bounded OS error formatting and UTF conversion. Read both manifests, README/changelog and every production Rust file (lib, Unix, Windows, WASI, Hermit). The prior ERANGE question was checked against GNU libc 2.42 xpg-strerror.c and musl 1.2.5 strerror_r.c: both terminate the supplied nonempty buffer on ERANGE. This is not a proof for every alternate libc/locale/OS: those platform contracts remain entrusted to the maintainer, not certified independently. Windows round-trip/error formatting tested locally. No network/build script or persistent storage in this crate. Exact archive SHA-256 e35d6e78f4cebb90e51d543db8fe41528851d6deeef6ef21ebd4bfdc1e784776, crates.io checksum/uploader/date/yank status, Cargo.lock and cached sparse index checked. One-day historical UTC window [start,end), only this named package; no future releases. ADR 0102 batch 6; evidence and limitations in review-2026-11-26-batch-6.json. Dependencies remain separate.

new_trusted_entries.name: siphasher
new_trusted_entries.notes: Проверено агентом, не человеком. Publisher trust for safe-to-deploy, not an independent complete source audit. Trust Frank Denis (jedisct1), named author and exact upstream release-commit author/publisher, for production SipHash 1-3/2-4 (64/128-bit), chunk/tail bounds, LE input loading and deployed hashing. Read both manifests, README and all production Rust (lib/common/sip/sip128); inspect unsafe loads, private state transitions, Clone/Default and serde derives. Only default/std is selected in current root, including workspace --all-features. Constructors maintain ntail < 8; arbitrary deserialized private state is not validated and must not be accepted from an untrusted source. This is maintainer trust, not a certificate that malformed serde state is valid. Noncryptographic hash-table/codegen use only: zero default keys do not provide adversarial collision resistance; Hasher integer methods are target-native and no constant-time or cryptographic authentication claim is made. Test vectors and exhaustive split/streaming checks run locally. Exact archive SHA-256 33f4fe9184a62d842c9ef383018f3306d8ba224fd9d836f56d7288308847c256, crates.io checksum/uploader/date/yank status, Cargo.lock and cached sparse index checked. One-day historical UTC window [start,end), only this named package; no future releases. ADR 0102 batch 6; evidence and limitations in review-2026-11-26-batch-6.json. Dependencies remain separate.

new_trusted_entries.name: openssl-src
new_trusted_entries.notes: Проверено агентом, не человеком. Publisher trust for safe-to-deploy, not an independent complete source audit. Read both manifests, pinned README, exact release patch and all Rust build-helper production code in src/lib.rs. Default output/build/install/remove paths remain under OUT_DIR/openssl-build; Configure runs in its copied source tree, --prefix points inside OUT_DIR; /usr/local/ssl / OPENSSL_CONFIG_DIR is runtime configuration metadata, not an installation target. Builds use local cc/Perl/make/nmake and packaged input, no download command; explicit caller out_dir/toolchain overrides remain trusted build configuration. Source/config/assembly payload: all 2425 packaged files present in the official OpenSSL 3.6.3 release archive match byte-for-byte, the remaining three packaging-only dotfiles match the official openssl-3.6.3 tag. Official archive SHA-256 243a86649cf6f23eeb6a2ff2456e09e5d77dd9018a54d3d96b0c6bdd6ba6c7f1 also matches the upstream checksum asset. вендоренный C/C++ совпадает с upstream OpenSSL 3.6.3; построчно агентом не аудирован; доверие к upstream-проекту. Trust Alex Crichton, exact release author/publisher, for packaging and build configuration; explicit trust to OpenSSL maintainers for deployed cryptographic C/ASM, not an independent cryptographic or toolchain audit. Legacy provider is enabled transitively by openssl-sys, not a claim all legacy algorithms are secure. No trust granted to openssl-sys or SQLCipher by this entry. Exact archive SHA-256 46eb8fb9fb3b61ce1c0f8a026c4c1a0714d3a9e138e7fbde78753ce2babc3846, crates.io checksum/uploader/date/yank status, Cargo.lock and cached sparse index checked.
